what: Six server pause points in the membership writers, each asking the stack's gate service whether to go on: a document's membership after its grants, parent folder and teams are read and before it is written (persistDocMembership: POST /access and every team re-fan), the same document's RTDB mirrors after its record is written, a folder's cascade after it writes the folder and before it reads the documents, and again after it reads them and before it writes them (recomputeSubtree), a team's members after it is read and before they are written (POST /team-members), and the RTDB mirrors POST /visibility rewrites from the members it read at its start. For deterministic interleavings of concurrent sharing changes: C16a (S18), C16b (S18, and the invitation a folder grant's cascade in flight leads to), C16c (S19), C16d (S20, and the mirror order of two POST /access). Its own helper (functions/src/lib/e2eAccessGate.ts), so it applies alone or beside the other amplify sets

gates.name: doc-membership-before-write
gates.where: functions/src/lib/folders.ts persistDocMembership: after the parent folder's membership and the team index are read and the document's membership computed from the grants its caller read, before the batch that writes grants and membership

gates.name: doc-mirror-before-write
gates.where: functions/src/lib/folders.ts persistDocMembership: after the batch is committed, before syncPresenceAccess rewrites presenceAccess/{d} and editAccess/{d} from the membership this call computed

gates.name: subtree-before-docs-read
gates.where: functions/src/lib/folders.ts recomputeSubtree: after the folder's own membership is written, before the query that reads the documents filed in it

gates.name: subtree-docs-before-write
gates.where: functions/src/lib/folders.ts recomputeSubtree: after a folder's documents are queried and their membership computed from the grants read then, before the batch that writes them

gates.name: team-members-after-read
gates.where: functions/src/index.ts manageTeamMembers: after the team is read, the caller authorized and the new member list computed, before it is written and the team re-fanned

gates.name: visibility-before-mirror
gates.where: functions/src/index.ts setVisibility: after the record and the public projection are written, before syncPresenceAccess rewrites the mirrors from the members read at the start of the request
